guidance.escalation_criteria: multiple transactions clustered just below an internal review threshold
guidance.chunk_text: Look specifically for a pattern of transactions sized just under a known reporting or review threshold, repeated across a short period. This is a specific red flag distinct from velocity alone and should be called out explicitly as a finding if present, with the actual amounts cited.

report.narrative_summary: Case CASE-003 involves a low severity velocity anomaly for Deepak Shetty, a salaried banking professional with a low risk rating and verified KYC status. Transaction analysis reveals a single transaction within the window (TXN-15941) for 33760, which is slightly below the baseline average with a deviation ratio of 0.9x. The reference text notes it as a family transfer with counterparty Aditya Pillai. No prior cases or documents on file were found. Further investigation can follow standard velocity closure documentation guidelines.
